patterns.name: Header
patterns.description: 64px (--header-height) on the canvas colour, no border until the page scrolls. 24px logo mark at the left edge; then the nav (two menu triggers with small chevrons, two plain links) in 14px #4d4d4d, the current page in #171717. Right edge: three 32px buttons 12px apart, two secondary and the dark one last.

patterns.name: Mega menu
patterns.description: Opening a nav trigger drops a full-width white panel under the header with a hairline below it. Three columns, each a small muted group label over a stack of large single-line links in #171717, some with a trailing north-east arrow for external pages. The page behind is washed out to about half strength, not darkened.

patterns.name: Home hero
patterns.description: Three zones on one row at 1440: a two-line 64px headline with two 40px pill buttons (dark then outlined) at the left, the large black triangle mark centred, and three short 16px lines stacked at the right that cycle. Lots of empty canvas above and below; no background image.

patterns.name: Logo row
patterns.description: Six monochrome customer logos spread edge to edge across the 1400px column, about 330px below the hero buttons.

patterns.name: Split showcase
patterns.description: A 56px two-line headline in a 673px left column, then a product illustration built from white panels with 1px rings, and at the right a two-tone 24px quote plus a small 'Features' label over 14px/500 links. The next section mirrors it with the headline on the right half.

patterns.name: Plan frame
patterns.description: Three plan columns share one 1px frame with 1px dividers; the middle (recommended) column is white, the others canvas. Each column: a small plan name (with a grey pill badge on the middle one), a large price with a small mono unit (the page inventory has 56px and 48px; which is the price was not isolated), 16px #4d4d4d description, a hairline, a 14px feature list with 16px line icons, and a 36px pill button at the bottom (dark only in the middle column).

patterns.name: Comparison table
patterns.description: Full 1400px width. A 36px pill search field and a 24px plan-name header row; then groups, each with a 16px line icon and 24px title, a 16px description and a hairline. Rows about 53px tall: 14px #4d4d4d label on the left, centred check marks or 14px values per plan, info icons after some labels, hairlines only between groups.

patterns.name: FAQ split
patterns.description: Headline (56px, two lines) in the left half; numbered accordion in the right half. Each row: two-digit number in #8f8f8f, 20px question in #171717, chevron at the far right; the open answer is 16px #4d4d4d under the question text.

patterns.name: Docs shell
patterns.description: Header with logo, a slash and the section name in 18px/600, then menu triggers. A 300px left sidebar on the canvas: a 36px search trigger with a key hint at the top, small muted group labels, 36px rows with chevrons for expandable items, and soft fades at its top and bottom edges as it scrolls. Main column 1024px.

patterns.name: Docs hero
patterns.description: Left: 56px/600 title, a lead paragraph in #4d4d4d (size not isolated), three 36px buttons (dark, then two outlined). Right: an underlined tab strip over a white terminal panel with a header row (icon, label, copy button) and 13px mono commands.

patterns.name: Card grid
patterns.description: Three columns of white 12px-radius link cards with 16px gaps: a 16px line icon, a 16px/600 title and a 13px #666666 description, 24px padding. Hover turns the card canvas colour over 0.25s.

patterns.name: Changelog list
patterns.description: Rows split by hairlines: a 13px date in a narrow left column, then an underlined 16px/500 title and an underlined 14px description.

patterns.name: Docs footer
patterns.description: 40px block padding, 24px inline, six link columns at 1440, three at 768, two at 390. The home page footer was not captured.

layout.responsive: The header stays 64px; at 390 it shows only the logo and a two-line menu icon (docs adds a three-dot button after the section name). Home hero at 768 and 390 becomes one centred column: mark, centred headline, a single mono sub-line, then full-width stacked pill buttons. Pricing plans stack into one column already at 768; the pricing h1 is 64px at 768 and 40px at 390. The docs sidebar is hidden at 768 and 390, the docs title is 48px, cards stack to one column. The sign-up card goes to 358px wide with 16px side margins at 390 and its title to 24px.

keyframes.name: overlay-fade-in
keyframes.use: Dialog and command menu backdrop; it stops at 0.8 opacity. --ds-overlay-backdrop-color is the lightest grey, so the backdrop is light, not dark.
keyframes.css: @keyframes overlay-fade-in { 0% { opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 0.8; } }

keyframes.name: overlay-fade-out
keyframes.use: Backdrop leaving.
keyframes.css: @keyframes overlay-fade-out { 0% { opacity: 0.8; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }

keyframes.name: overlay-scale-in
keyframes.use: Dialog and command menu panel entering; --ds-motion-overlay-scale is .96.
keyframes.css: @keyframes overlay-scale-in { 0% { transform: scale(var(--ds-motion-overlay-scale)); opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

keyframes.name: overlay-scale-out
keyframes.use: Dialog and command menu panel leaving.
keyframes.css: @keyframes overlay-scale-out { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 100% { transform: scale(var(--ds-motion-overlay-scale)); opacity: 0; } }

keyframes.name: command-loading
keyframes.use: Indeterminate bar while the command menu searches.
keyframes.css: @keyframes command-loading { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-100%); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(300%); } }

keyframes.name: nav-enter-from-left
keyframes.use: Navigation menu content when moving to an item on the left; served with the auth pages.
keyframes.css: @keyframes nav-enter-from-left { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-200px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(0px); } }

keyframes.name: nav-enter-from-right
keyframes.use: Navigation menu content when moving to an item on the right.
keyframes.css: @keyframes nav-enter-from-right { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(200px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(0px); } }

keyframes.name: nav-exit-to-left

keyframes.css: @keyframes nav-exit-to-left { 0% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(0px); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-200px); } }

keyframes.name: nav-exit-to-right
keyframes.use: Outgoing navigation menu content.

unmeasured: Hover on filled and outlined buttons: forced hover produced no measurable change on any of them, so their hover colour is not recorded. The only observed variant is #383838 on the dark auth button right after a click.

Running durations of most keyframes: the CSS is recorded but nothing was running when measured. Timings above come from the platform's --animate-* variables where one names the keyframe; the rest have none.
The home hero: a canvas fades in over 1.2s linear and the triangle mark is drawn in it; what the canvas animates is script-driven and not specified.
The three hero lines cycle by script. Only their CSS transitions (colour 0.5s, height 0.2s, detail opacity 0.3s) were measured, not the interval.
Everything on home below the second showcase rendered blank in the capture (it loads on scroll), so those sections and their motion are not recorded.

Sign up: a script-driven Web Animation (Motion) runs filter blur(0px) to blur(5px) on a div over 5100ms with a 110ms delay and a long linear() spring curve. The customer line under the card changes between screenshots; that this animation drives it is likely but not confirmed.
The mega menu, dropdowns and accordions were seen open, but their open and close motion was not captured as it ran.
Focus on the auth email field: no measured difference; screenshots show a soft grey double ring.

principles: Paint the page #fafafa and put white (#ffffff) only on things you can act on or read as a unit: buttons, cards, the highlighted plan, the auth card.
Use two text colours for almost everything: #171717 for what matters and #4d4d4d for the rest. Reach for #666666 and #8f8f8f only for small secondary text and icons.
Draw edges with a 1px box-shadow ring (#ebebeb or rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)), not borders. Add the 2px soft drop only on the few surfaces that float.
Set headlines in Geist with heavy negative tracking (-0.06em on display sizes) at weight 400 to 600; never bold 700.
Interface text is 14px. Buttons are 32px in headers, 36px in content, 40px in heroes and forms.
One dark #171717 button per group. Pair it with white ringed buttons; colour is never used for a button fill.
Blue #0072f5 is for focus rings and auth links only. The focus ring is a 2px white gap plus a 2px blue ring.
Keep motion short and plain: 0.1s for link colours, 0.15s with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for controls, 0.2s to 0.3s with a slight overshoot for popovers and overlays.
avoid: Visible drop shadows on cards that sit on the canvas
Text in pure #000000 for body copy (it is reserved for docs card titles and the selected tab)
Weights of 700 and above, and positive letter spacing on headings
Custom-styled validation errors on simple auth forms; the platform relies on native browser validation
Dark overlays behind menus: the mega menu washes the page out with white instead
